Title: Entry Level Software Engineer - Site Reliability (Remote - Mexico)
Industries: Software Development, Technology, Information and Internet, and Advertising Services
Description: Summary Yelp engineering culture is driven by our values: we’re a cooperative team that values individual authenticity and encourages creative solutions to problems. All new engineers deploy working code their first week, and we strive to broaden individual impact with support from managers, mentors, and teams. At the end of the day, we’re all about helping our users, growing as engineers, and having fun in a collaborative environment. Do you want to help build and manage scaleable, globally-distributed systems? Our Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) keep Yelp fast, available, and growing. We make sure users can always connect to great local businesses through our platform. No matter how many times we get searched, scraped, scanned, spammed, pinged, paged, or queried, we keep our cool, and keep the site running smoothly. We welcome both early-career SRE Engineers and entry-level Software Engineers with strong backend fundamentals who are interested in transitioning into site reliability engineering. No previous SRE or infrastructure experience is required, just your coding skills, a passion for learning, and a desire to make an impact on the reliability and scalability of complex systems supporting millions of users. You’ll be mentored by experienced SREs and gain hands-on experience with the unique challenges of operating at global scale. SREs at Yelp work in both the software development and systems worlds, implementing key parts of Yelp’s core architecture and supporting developers as they do the same. We get to take on interesting challenges that you can only find from operating a platform that serves over 100 million users per month. As an entry-level Site Reliability Engineer, you’ll help keep our platforms fast, available, and secure by building automation, improving observability, and partnering with developers so features ship confidently. This opportunity is fully remote and does not require you to be located in any particular area in Mexico. We welcome applicants from throughout Mexico. We’d love to have you apply, even if you don’t feel you meet every single requirement in this posting. At Yelp, we’re looking for great people, not just those who simply check off all the boxes. What You'll Do Work with a globally distributed team based in multiple countries. Collaborate with engineers in supporting new features and services. Contribute to production code by writing and shipping code alongside your team. Build tools to monitor site stability and performance. Help ensure the reliability and scalability of our infrastructure, while maintaining platform Service Level Objectives (SLOs). Troubleshoot site issues using industry-leading tools like Splunk, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. Develop your skills in Python, Puppet, Git, Jenkins, and Terraform to automate everything and leverage an extensive suite of AI tooling. Develop custom tools when off-the-shelf solutions don’t work at our scale and contribute upstream to open source projects. Empower product teams and developers by championing automation and self-service. Participate in light on-call rotations. We have geographically distributed SRE teams for follow-the-sun support, which means nobody needs to be on-call 24h a day! What It Takes To Succeed All communication for this role, both spoken and written, will be conducted in English. Familiarity with Linux and an enthusiasm for learning more (we use Ubuntu but any distribution is fine). Skill in at least one of your favourite modern programming languages: Python, Ruby, Go, Java, C++, etc. Knowledge of public cloud platforms (we use AWS, but experience with Azure/GCP is fine). An eagerness to ask questions, take initiative and learn everyday. What You'll Get This opportunity has the option to be fully remote in all locations across Mexico. Full responsibility to contribute to and lead projects from day one. A dynamic, collaborative, global and diverse team environment. Competitive salary and bonus structure. A competitive benefits package that includes paid time off and remote work reimbursements. Flexible working hours and meeting-free Wednesdays. Regular 3-day Hackathons and bi-weekly learning groups. Opportunities to participate in virtual events and conferences. Quarterly team offsites. Closing At Yelp, we believe that diversity is an expression of all the unique characteristics that make us human: race, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, disability, and education — and those are just a few. We recognize that diverse backgrounds and perspectives strengthen our teams and our product. Title: Senior Data Engineer
Description: We are looking for a senior Data Engineer to join the Artsy team. You will help develop the analytics and machine learning data pipelines that support Artsy’s business operations and product features. This can involve challenges in data warehousing, orchestration, and infrastructure. Data is core to Artsy’s marketplace, and this role will be responsible for shaping the platform, practices, and workflows driving both product and business insights. Data Platform is a workstream within Artsy's Platform engineering team that enables other product teams to develop data-driven products. The team manages all our ELT pipelines, ensuring acceptable reliability and data quality standards are met. You will report to the Engineer Manager, who leads the Core Platform team. Our data platform relies on AWS for cloud infrastructure, including Redshift for warehousing, Airflow for orchestration on Kubernetes; DBT for data modeling; some use of Spark for data processing; and Python as the core language. We integrate with services like Segment and Looker and continuously evaluate new patterns, tools, and technologies. The Core Engineering Platform team is technically diverse, with team members working on infrastructure, security, and development tooling. We release continuously and test often with a focus on reliability, developer experience, and high-quality engineering enablement. What You’ll Do At Artsy You’ll architect systems for scale, with a focus on data quality and platform reliability. You'll work cross-functionally with data analysts, platform engineers, and product engineers. You'll influence the direction of our data platform roadmap, including our analytics pipelines and personalization features. You'll support the operations of data platform systems, including observability and requests to our team. You’ll work with the data infrastructure to maintain and improve the data availability for the whole company. You’ll help structure our data, so it’s an invaluable asset in our dynamic business environment. This Role Is a Fit For You If You enjoy evolving infrastructure as part of a team, pushing the boundaries of Artsy's platform. Have experience working in a platform role, providing both knowledge and tooling to your non-platform engineer colleagues. You are currently authorized to live and work in Berlin or London [Optional] It’s a plus if you/it’s even better if you… If you have experience standardizing and scaling Machine Learning operations If you have experience with data security This role is unlikely to be a good match if you…. Don't like interacting outside the data platform team. Don't like to look for opportunities to optimize data platform systems. Think that the data platform scope is limited to data pipelines What Success Looks Like In Your First 3-6 Months Full grasp of the data platform systems Can contribute effectively to the data platform roadmap Work together with other teams, like pairing with the data analysts We know no one is a perfect match on paper, so if you’re passionate about this role, please apply! We’re excited to learn how your skills, experiences, and insights could make a difference. How We Will Evaluate Your Skills Our standard interview process looks like: Talent Acquisition Interview Hiring Manager Interview Work Exercise/Design System interview Team Interview with Close Collaborators (focused on the core skills for the role and our values) Final Interview with Leadership If you are selected to interview for the Sr Data Engineer position, we will share a detailed guide on what you can expect from the hiring process and how to prepare for each stage. Please note that we do not accept applications sent by email. You should submit your application directly through our careers website! Artsy Values Artsy has five core values that will inform your experience at Artsy. For the Love of Art: We show relentless curiosity, empathy, and passion for collectors, artists, gallerists, and the art market. We take action to make the art world more fair and welcoming.
